description.value: The Royal Kelowna is a waterfront all-suite luxury resort in downtown Kelowna, situated directly on Okanagan Lake with condo-style suites featuring gourmet kitchens, in-suite laundry, and furnished balconies with lake or lagoon views. Managed by Bellstar Hotels & Resorts, the property's rooftop offers a heated infinity pool, hot tubs, fitness centre, and BBQs. Its lakefront location in downtown Kelowna puts touring cyclists close to the city's waterfront paths and Okanagan amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and rich with detail. Secure storage for guests' own touring bikes is never mentioned; the hotel offers seasonal loaner adult bikes via the Stay® amenities program, which is a different thing. In-suite laundry (washer & dryer in all units) and complimentary Wi-Fi are explicitly confirmed on the /rooms page, and the OSM internet_access tags align with the website. Phone and address match between OSM and the /contact page.
concerns: Website footer shows postal code V1Y 9P3 in one location but V1Y 9P4 in all other locations (front page, /contact, /stay-amenities); V1Y 9P4 appears to be the current correct code.
The hotel offers loaner adult bikes (seasonal, via Stay® amenities) but no mention of secure storage for guests' own touring bikes — the two should not be conflated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable waterfront hotel in downtown Kelowna with a live website and confirmed contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Stay® amenities program provides seasonal adult bike loans to guests; cyclists should contact the front desk to confirm availability and whether e-bike charging or bike storage can be arranged.

Laundry.detail: In-suite laundry (washer & dryer) listed as a standard feature in all units on the /rooms page

Nearby evening food.detail: Neighbouring Playtime Casino Kelowna has a neighbourhood pub-style restaurant, mentioned on /amenities page

price.label: Luxury
price.signal: Explicit 'Waterfront Luxury Suites' and 'luxurious resort' branding with spa services
